description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed Mr. T. E. Santharajan as the arbitrator for the Settlement of Industrial Disputes between 13 Employees including Mrs. W. L. P. Imali Maheshani and Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority and between 09 Employees including Mrs. P. D. Ishanka Maduwanthi and Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau
